title: Uncertainty Cave
body:

Description

The Uncertainty Cave is a speciality cave located at the bottom of Ferwater Island's desertlands' fissure. To navigate to the cave, players must go through the Oke Caves, the caves of the desertlands, into the canyon. It is best to be careful as the Boomite Caves are also connected to the Oke Caves. Another way to access the cave is to drive off into the fissure and flip the vehicle once landed, granted there are no trailers.

The Uncertainty Cave is characterized by a deep purple fog and lightly-colored lavender sands. The cave is expansive with high ceilings and multiple levels within the same cavern.

Mysterious Mushrooms on the ceiling of the cave shoot poisonous spores at the player, requiring the player to hide and heal as they explore the cave. The spore projectiles confer an anti-gravity effect to the player, allowing them to float and reach the ceiling of the cave. It is recommended that the player have a Healing Coil (bought from the Classic Store) to quickly regenerate health while exploring the cave.

There are three walls that can be broken with explosives in Uncertainty Cave. One leads to the entrance of Fungi Finds. The other two walls are both secret entrances to Fusion Lake containing Oobmab, a purple species of Bamboo, along with Tamed Mysterious Mushrooms, a unique flower.

Resources

The cave is home to five types of Mushrooms - Red, Green, Blue, Purple, and Mysterious Mushrooms. The former four mushroom types spawn on the ground, while Mysterious Mushrooms spawn on the ceiling of the cave. The different colors of Mushrooms have equal monetary value regardless of color (except the Mysterious variety). Mysterious Mushrooms offer a much higher profit, both for its wood and cap.

The last type of wood available in Uncertainty Cave is Oobmab wood, which can be farmed at the hidden lake behind the explodable walls adjacent to Fungi Finds.

Uncertainty Cave is also the only spawn location for Fungoidite nodes, which can have one rare ore type - Fungiviolet. No other ores spawn in Fungoidite nodes, and Fungiviolet ores have a distinct neon glow that can be seen without a Flashlight.

Stores

There are two shops located in Uncertainty Cave:

  • Fungi Finds (Shop)
  • Pirate Boat Shop

Fungi Finds is a secret shop hidden behind a destructible wall. This shop offers mainly decoration and quality-of-life items, such as Dice, Music Discs, and three statue decorations; Kallostide, Moai, and Mysterious Teacups.

The Pirate Boat shop sells high-tier explosives, which can be used on breakable walls. This shop moves around the map, with the dock at Uncertainty Cave being a potential location for this shop. The explosives this shop offers are convenient for accessing Fungi Finds and the Oobmab spawn location, both of which require explosives to enter.

Special Quests

There are three secret quests that require the use of Uncertainty Cave to complete:

  • Refined/Forged Inkstone can be enchanted into ? ? ? when it comes in contact with a spore projectile, then it will turn into a neon pink block. This special ore is useful in completing the Uncertain Pickaxe quest. The special  ? ? ? ore is used to be placed on pedestals at specific points around the map, summoning the one and only Uncertain Pickaxe.
  • Fusion Lake or Oobmab Lake is required for the Fusion Coil quest. Firstly, the player must use explosives - at minimum, a Small Bomb - to destroy one of the two breakable walls and open the entrance. By placing a Healing Coil, a Speed Coil, a Gravity Coil, and an Infused Core into the lake, the materials combine to create a Fusion Coil. The coils can be bought from the Classic Store, and the Infused Core can be created by taking a Meteor Core from the site of a meteorite impact and putting it into contact with a spore projectile from a Mysterious Mushroom.
  • Tamed Mysterious Mushrooms from the Fusion Lake can be used in a multiple part quest to obtain the elusive Petalbloom, obtained at multiple shrines that need to hold a specific flower from multiple locations.

Other

In the place where you combine coils to make a Fusion Coil. Now there is an entrance to The Void.

Trivia

  • When selling any type of Mushroom, note that the caps of Mushrooms are considered wood. Mushroom caps should be cut off from the stalk and sold raw for the most profit, as they are destroyed when sanded. *I recommend to not sand the caps on accident lol*
  • The cave is likely to be inspired in the Purple Cave from Refinery Caves due to the fact that both are related to mushrooms and both contain a water source.
